<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
<plist version="1.0">
<dict>
  <key>harbor.after</key>
  <dict>
    <key>NSStringLocalizedFormatKey</key>
    <string>%#@count@</string>
    <key>count</key>
    <dict>
      <key>NSStringFormatSpecTypeKey</key>
      <string>NSStringPluralRuleType</string>
      <key>NSStringFormatValueTypeKey</key>
      <string>d</string>
      <key>one</key>
      <string>%d%n %@ beacon</string>
      <key>other</key>
      <string>%d%n %@ beacons</string>
    </dict>
  </dict>
  <key>harbor.repeated</key>
  <dict>
    <key>NSStringLocalizedFormatKey</key>
    <string>%#@count@</string>
    <key>count</key>
    <dict>
      <key>NSStringFormatSpecTypeKey</key>
      <string>NSStringPluralRuleType</string>
      <key>NSStringFormatValueTypeKey</key>
      <string>d</string>
      <key>one</key>
      <string>%d%n%n %@ beacon</string>
      <key>other</key>
      <string>%d%n%n %@ beacons</string>
    </dict>
  </dict>
  <key>harbor.explicit</key>
  <dict>
    <key>NSStringLocalizedFormatKey</key>
    <string>%#@count@</string>
    <key>count</key>
    <dict>
      <key>NSStringFormatSpecTypeKey</key>
      <string>NSStringPluralRuleType</string>
      <key>NSStringFormatValueTypeKey</key>
      <string>d</string>
      <key>one</key>
      <string>%d %3$n %2$@ beacon</string>
      <key>other</key>
      <string>%d %3$n %2$@ beacons</string>
    </dict>
  </dict>
  <key>harbor.overlap</key>
  <dict>
    <key>NSStringLocalizedFormatKey</key>
    <string>%#@count@</string>
    <key>count</key>
    <dict>
      <key>NSStringFormatSpecTypeKey</key>
      <string>NSStringPluralRuleType</string>
      <key>NSStringFormatValueTypeKey</key>
      <string>d</string>
      <key>one</key>
      <string>%d %2$n %@ beacon</string>
      <key>other</key>
      <string>%d %2$n %@ beacons</string>
    </dict>
  </dict>
  <key>harbor.positioned</key>
  <dict>
    <key>NSStringLocalizedFormatKey</key>
    <string>%#@count@</string>
    <key>count</key>
    <dict>
      <key>NSStringFormatSpecTypeKey</key>
      <string>NSStringPluralRuleType</string>
      <key>NSStringFormatValueTypeKey</key>
      <string>d</string>
      <key>one</key>
      <string>%d%n %3$@ beacon</string>
      <key>other</key>
      <string>%d%n %3$@ beacons</string>
    </dict>
  </dict>
  <key>harbor.escaped</key>
  <dict>
    <key>NSStringLocalizedFormatKey</key>
    <string>%#@count@</string>
    <key>count</key>
    <dict>
      <key>NSStringFormatSpecTypeKey</key>
      <string>NSStringPluralRuleType</string>
      <key>NSStringFormatValueTypeKey</key>
      <string>d</string>
      <key>one</key>
      <string>%d%%n %@ beacon</string>
      <key>other</key>
      <string>%d%%n %@ beacons</string>
    </dict>
  </dict>
  <key>harbor.unicode.🧭</key>
  <dict>
    <key>NSStringLocalizedFormatKey</key>
    <string>%#@count@</string>
    <key>count</key>
    <dict>
      <key>NSStringFormatSpecTypeKey</key>
      <string>NSStringPluralRuleType</string>
      <key>NSStringFormatValueTypeKey</key>
      <string>d</string>
      <key>one</key>
      <string>%d%n %@ 🧭</string>
      <key>other</key>
      <string>%d%n %@ 🧭🧭</string>
    </dict>
  </dict>
</dict>
</plist>
